topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture and outlines its focus on the initiation and resolution of inflammation.

topics.label: Innate immune recognition and pattern recognition receptor signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system senses pathogens and damage through molecular patterns and transduces these signals via pattern recognition receptors.

topics.label: Leukocyte recruitment and systemic inflammatory responses
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how sentinel cells coordinate leukocyte extravasation into tissues, facilitate drainage to prime adaptive immunity, and risk triggering systemic pathology when overactivated.

topics.label: Resolution of inflammation, tissue repair, and chronic inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the mechanisms that terminate inflammation, restore damaged tissue, and result in chronic inflammation or granulomas when resolution fails.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the next lecture on complement.
